assessment_scope: Formal lifecycle Delivery Review of exactly registered primary plan docs/plans/2026-09-15-retire-legacy-design-authoring.md at a06a910c, against current approved design-review-r2 and exact design/skill/system members. Sequencing and verification allocation assessed together; no standalone test-spec member.
independence_basis: Reviewer /root/retirement_review independently read the entire primary plan at a06a910c and inspected relevant current implementation/check interfaces. Root authored the plan; reviewer authored neither delivery allocation nor Design/implementation content. Earlier Design assessment is separate from this Delivery judgment.
limitations: This judgment approves only the exact delivery allocation for authorized implementation; it does not claim implementation correctness, executed milestone proof, final readiness or external-action permission.
The future semantic and candidate observations must be performed on actual revised resources and recorded; this review evaluates their sufficiency and feasibility, not their eventual outcome.
rationale: Scope and traceability: DES-SR-24 maps to the supported-output/retirement boundary in M1 and TG-01/02 plus both final groups; DES-SR-06/13/14/21 map source/decision preservation to TG-01/F01; DES-SR-15/17/18/19 map package and consumer closure to TG-02/F02; DES-SR-23 retains feature methods and projections. The plan also explicitly covers DES-SR-16 exact handoff in F01 and all eight affected scenario dimensions without inventing a proof-record contract.

Safe sequence: approved proposal, corrected exact Design Review and this Delivery gate precede implementation. Fail-first retirement/unknown-resource tests precede production edits; instructions, five-file removals and current validators form one reviewable rollback unit. A template-only or validator-only intermediate state cannot qualify as a complete package.

Source and authority proof: TG-FINAL-01 requires an independent nonauthor to inspect actual full revised package against new living output, ADR edit with mandatory local template, architecture rebuild, mixed-source authorized adoption and retained feature amendment. Required observations include selected resources, concrete model-field meaning, unchanged prohibited source mutation, remaining owner and exact reviewer/Plan handoff; unsupported output and missing authority are distinguishable. This is explicitly semantic artifact inspection rather than unobserved agent-execution proof.

Test maintenance: actual current DESIGN_RESOURCES and package-map tests enforce the three retiring skill resources; traceability and no-mutable-state tests also include old skeletons. TG-02 explicitly replaces obsolete presence expectations with resurrection rejection, valid package control, unknown-before-missing checks and retained-resource absence/containment. Generic path-lint fixtures, retained asset protection and feature projections remain; retirement of exclusive format tests is Design-authorized rather than justified by passing count.

Installed boundary and feasibility: existing build-adapters and validate-adapters --clean-install-smoke --skill design support the specified fresh Codex/Claude candidate and temporary install. TG-FINAL-02 separately requires complete current resource parity under declared transforms and absence of all three retired resources; actual hashes and independent assessment prevent treating a builder success as sufficient. Repository copies and current loading callers are checked separately from historical records and path fixtures.

Validation placement: V1 validates all canonical skills, V2 includes focused changed classes then full suite, V3 protects packaging/install regressions, V4 observes actual candidate/temporary install, V5 current records and selected local CI, and V6 the full original-base branch. HEAD/DIR must be resolved to concrete identities; proof cannot be reused across relevant source/candidate drift. These commands exist and require no new dependency or customer installation.

Risk, compatibility and recovery: one milestone bounds deliberate external compatibility withdrawal; unchanged feature methods, retained source authority, alternate stale loaders and invalid resource populations have distinct proof. Recovery restores the entire coupled source/check set from the recorded base, preserves user work/evidence, reruns affected proof and requires reassessment. No state migration, schema change, external publication or forceful installation is introduced.

Independent gates: all allocated local/integrated observations are required before M1 can pass review. The final whole-change Code Review checkpoint explicitly follows completed M1 and corrections and precedes distinct Verify; neither one-milestone approval nor integrated groups substitute for it. Final original-base CI has a separate V6 scope. Review evidence expectations include actual subjects, contributor separation and concern disposition.

Current reliance: primary plan identity matches registry; corrected three-model package and design-review-r2 approval remain unchanged, rda-dr-01 is reporter-resolved. Evidence-container append after Design Review does not alter its engineering judgment; the original design-authoring enclosing-model pass is not substituted for explicit example-correction proof. No unresolved material finding, necessary decision or unrealistic allocation blocks implementation readiness.
summary: One coupled milestone safely reconciles the five retired files, supported guidance, consumers and validation. Requirement-linked semantic, negative-resource, candidate and whole-branch proof plus separate milestone/final reviews and Verify are adequate and feasible.
